main.description: Block a domain (and with it all its subdomains), or allow it to clear a false positive of the synced list or the built-in entries. An admin entry wins over every other entry; a domain has at most one (block or allow). Logged. Safety admins only; requires service auth for the indexer.

domain.description: A domain name, or a URL whose host is used. Internationalized names are stored in punycode.
